diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Understand your current state and get the next practical step.
diagnostics.description:
16 questions, 7-10 minutes. Progress saves automatically, results show inline.

The test covers key psychosomatic areas: sleep, energy, digestion, anxiety and more. Based on your answers you'll get a personalized profile and recommendations.

about.title: About project & author
about.methodBody: A synthesis of over 22 years of work with the body, consciousness, and state, plus the experience of 2000+ clients. I have combined the principles of osteopathy, the depth of ancient practices, and the achievements of modern neurophysiology into a single, logically built system.
about.roleTitle: My role as a space guide
about.roleBody1: I share my personal practical experience and lived path.
about.roleBody2: I pass on only working, proven practices and methods.
about.roleBody3: I conduct meditations and somatic tunings.
about.roleBody4: I help distinguish the True from the False and accompany you out of other people's scenarios into your real life.
